title: Release-evidence sources
description: The private list bin/release-report.mjs --fetch reads (monitor/private/releases.json): one deploy box per entry. The box's forced command prints the release-evidence document, so no remote command is sent. A key path may start with ~/.

product.description: Names the stored documents and the report directory; must equal the product the box reports.

ssh.description: user@host. Cannot start with a dash, so it cannot be read as an ssh option.
